thought.text: Both creations failed — BusyBox wget lacks `--header-file`. I'll run the POSTs from a throwaway curl container on the compose network.

reasoning_content:
Both are empty. In other words, the school creation didn't go through. The `--header-file` option isn't supported in the first place (it was rejected as an unrecognized option). That means the first wget also errored out (exit code 2) — no wait, in the previous execution, after displaying "--- Create school:", nothing was displayed, and then the teacher command errored out. In fact, the first command also had the unrecognized option `--header-file`, so it should have failed with exit code 2, but the output was captured in a different way... In the output, nothing was shown under "--- Create school:". In other words, the school wasn't created.

I need another way to POST. Options:
1. The ml-service container has curl (apt install curl in the Dockerfile). Run the POST from the ml-service container.
2. The qdrant container — no curl.
3. Run a small throwaway container on the compose network that has curl (e.g., `docker run --rm --network workspace_default curlimages/curl ...`).

Option 3 is the cleanest. curlimages/curl is a public image. Let's use that.

action.command:
cd /workspace && SA=$(grep '^SUPER_ADMIN_API_KEY=' .env | cut -d= -f2)
docker run --rm --network workspace_default -e SA_KEY="$SA" curlimages/curl:latest -sS -X POST http://backend:4000/api/v1/school/create-one-school -H "x-super-admin-api-key: $SA_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"name":"Eckener-Schule Flensburg","slug":"eckener-schule"}' -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n"

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace && SA=$(grep '^SUPER_ADMIN_API_KEY=' .env | cut -d= -f2)\ndocker run --rm --network workspace_default -e SA_KEY=\"$SA\" curlimages/curl:latest -sS -X POST http://backend:4000/api/v1/school/create-one-school -H \"x-super-admin-api-key: $SA_KEY\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" -d '{\"name\":\"Eckener-Schule Flensburg\",\"slug\":\"eckener-schule\"}' -w \"\\nHTTP:%{http_code}\\n\"", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "summary": "Create school via curl container"}
